_provenance.purpose: Regenerate candidate sets semantically over all 207 QSEN statements for the 26 rows not covered by candidate_regeneration_v2.json, so that one candidate-generation method covers the whole 36-row table.
_provenance.also: Verifies every not_mappable claim against the full index rather than inferring it from a filler candidate set, and resolves the shared-source-task inconsistencies carried in v1.

RN-WPS-002.concept: Administer anesthetics or sedatives to control pain.
RN-WPS-002.rationale: Administering an anesthetic or sedative to control pain is the initiation of a treatment to relieve pain and suffering.
RN-WPS-002.notes: v1 top CONFIRMED against the full index. The regenerated set adds the medication-safety family (QSEN_0158, QSEN_0150, QSEN_0160) so the reviewer can choose the safe-administration reading instead if preferred.

RN-WPS-004.concept: Advise communities or institutions regarding health or safety issues.
RN-WPS-004.rationale: Consulting with institutions and associations on health and safety issues is the use of national patient safety resources to focus attention on safety in care settings.
RN-WPS-004.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0161, whose scope is hazards and errors communicated to patients, families and the team. Institutional and policy engagement remains thin across QSEN; AACN Domains 3 and 9-10 carry it better.

RN-WPS-005.concept: Advise medical personnel regarding healthcare issues.
RN-WPS-005.rationale: Directing an infection control programme and advising personnel on necessary precautions is participating as a team member to design, promote and model strategies that reduce risk of harm.
RN-WPS-005.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0169 (report errors), which fitted poorly. Shares source task with RN-WPS-014, which now receives the same top.

RN-WPS-006.concept: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.
RN-WPS-006.rationale: Interpreting and evaluating diagnostic data to inform care is searching, retrieving and managing data to make decisions using information and knowledge management systems.
RN-WPS-006.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0095, which is about how evidence strength influences care rather than about interpreting a patient's results, and which is Knowledge where the task is a Skill. Shares source task with RN-WPS-026, which now receives the same top.

RN-WPS-007.concept: Assess patient work, living, or social environments.
RN-WPS-007.rationale: Assessing the needs of individuals, families and communities is eliciting their values, preferences and expressed needs as part of assessment and care planning.
RN-WPS-007.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0161. The task has two clauses: assess needs and environments, then identify health or safety problems. QSEN_0013 covers the first, QSEN_0161 the second. The concept label emphasises assessment, so the first clause leads.

RN-WPS-009.concept: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
RN-WPS-009.rationale: Consulting and coordinating with team members to assess, plan, implement and evaluate care plans is integrating the contributions of others who help the patient achieve health goals.
RN-WPS-009.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0014. QSEN_0066 was absent from the lexical candidate set and is the better fit: v1's statement is about communicating patient values, this one is about integrating team contributions into the plan.

RN-WPS-010.concept: Communicate health and wellness information to the public.
RN-WPS-010.rationale: Instructing individuals, families and groups on health education and disease prevention is engaging them in partnerships that promote health, safety, well-being and self-care management.
RN-WPS-010.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0006, a Knowledge statement about describing empowerment strategies, where the task is a Skill. Population-level programme development still has no QSEN counterpart; that half belongs to AACN Domain 3.

RN-WPS-011.concept: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.
RN-WPS-011.rationale: Engaging in nursing research activities is participating effectively in data collection and other research activities.
RN-WPS-011.notes: v1 top CONFIRMED against the full index and still the strongest mapping in the table. QSEN_0098 (IRB adherence) is added as an alternate; it was absent from the lexical set.

RN-WPS-013.rationale: Verified against all 207 statements: QSEN contains no diagnostic-reasoning competency. The only statement naming diagnosis, QSEN_0095, is about how evidence strength influences care, not about forming a diagnosis.
RN-WPS-013.notes: v1 status CONFIRMED, now on evidence rather than inference. Shares source task with RN-WPS-016 and RN-WPS-039; all three are not_mappable in v3. Route to AACN Domain 2 and the NCJMM clinical judgment layer.

RN-WPS-014.rationale: Directing and coordinating an infection control programme is participating as a team member to design, promote and model strategies that reduce risk of harm.
RN-WPS-014.notes: CHANGED from not_mappable. The full index does contain participate-in-designing-systems statements (QSEN_0074, QSEN_0102, QSEN_0163, QSEN_0166, QSEN_0167) that the lexical set never offered. Shares source task with RN-WPS-005 and now carries the same top, resolving a v1 inconsistency.

RN-WPS-015.concept: Evaluate patient outcomes to determine effectiveness of treatments.
RN-WPS-015.rationale: Modifying a treatment plan in response to the patient's condition is initiating changes in approaches to care when evaluation warrants other options for improving outcomes.
RN-WPS-015.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0134, which was flagged for a level mismatch: it measures the effect of a system-level change, where the task is patient-level. QSEN_0105 is patient-level and was absent from the lexical set. The mismatch flag is resolved.

RN-WPS-016.concept: Examine patients to assess general physical condition.
RN-WPS-016.rationale: Verified against all 207 statements: QSEN has no general physical-assessment competency. Its only assessment statements concern pain (QSEN_0015), comfort (QSEN_0016), decisional conflict (QSEN_0020) and the nurse's own communication skill (QSEN_0024).
RN-WPS-016.notes: CHANGED from draft_mapping — a deliberate downgrade. v1 mapped 'perform physical examinations' onto 'assess levels of physical and emotional comfort', which a reviewer would rightly reject. Shares source task with RN-WPS-013 and RN-WPS-039; all three now agree.

RN-WPS-017.rationale: The source task is broad care delivery — health care, first aid, immunisation, and convalescent or rehabilitative assistance — which is providing patient-centred care with sensitivity and respect for the diversity of human experience.
RN-WPS-017.notes: CHANGED from not_mappable, and it resolves a v1 inconsistency: RN-WPS-038 has the identical source task and v1 drafted it onto QSEN_0029 while refusing this row. Map from the task, not the concept label. Immunisation as a population intervention still belongs to AACN Domain 3.

RN-WPS-019.concept: Maintain inventory of medical supplies or equipment.
RN-WPS-019.rationale: Preparing rooms, sterile instruments and supplies and keeping stock maintained is carried out through standardized practices that support safety and quality.
RN-WPS-019.notes: CHANGED from not_mappable, resolving the inconsistency flagged in the v1 packet: RN-WPS-027 has the identical source task and was drafted onto QSEN_0158 while this row was refused. Both now agree. Inventory and resource stewardship as a systems function still belongs to AACN Domain 7.

RN-WPS-021.rationale: Taking responsibility for a unit's staff is participating in designing systems that support effective teamwork.
RN-WPS-021.notes: PARTIAL COVERAGE, stated plainly. The task names staff, budget, planning and long-range goals. Only the staffing clause has a QSEN counterpart; budget and strategic planning have none anywhere in the 207. CHANGED from not_mappable on the strength of the staffing clause alone — a reviewer who wants whole-task coverage should return it to not_mappable and route it to AACN Domains 7 and 10.

RN-WPS-022.concept: Monitor health or behavior of people or animals.
RN-WPS-022.rationale: Observing nurses and visiting patients to ensure proper nursing care is using quality measures to understand performance.
RN-WPS-022.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0192 and now identical to RN-WPS-035, which shares the source task and received a different top in v1. The concept label 'Monitor health or behavior of people or animals' remains a generic O*NET work-activity label; map from the task.

RN-WPS-026.concept: Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.
RN-WPS-026.rationale: Ordering, interpreting and evaluating diagnostic tests is searching, retrieving and managing data to make decisions using information and knowledge management systems.
RN-WPS-026.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0091 so that this row and RN-WPS-006, which share the identical source task, now agree. Test ordering may exceed RN scope in some jurisdictions; flag alongside the prescribing rows if the reviewer is drawing a scope line.

RN-WPS-027.concept: Prepare medical supplies or equipment for use.
RN-WPS-027.rationale: Preparing sterile instruments, equipment and supplies is the use of standardized practices that support safety and quality.
RN-WPS-027.notes: v1 top CONFIRMED. Identical candidate set and top to RN-WPS-019, which shares the source task — the v1 inconsistency between these two rows is resolved.

RN-WPS-029.concept: Prescribe assistive medical devices or related treatments.
RN-WPS-029.rationale: Verified against all 207 statements: QSEN contains no prescribing competency, and prescribing exceeds the registered-nurse scope this crosswalk targets.
RN-WPS-029.notes: v1 status CONFIRMED on evidence. SCOPE MISMATCH: the row derives from an O*NET registered-nurse profile that blends RN and advanced-practice tasks. Recommend moving to the source exclusion list beside *CIP Code and Provider rather than leaving it in the review queue.

RN-WPS-030.rationale: Verified against all 207 statements: no prescribing competency exists in QSEN, and prescribing exceeds registered-nurse scope.
RN-WPS-030.notes: v1 status CONFIRMED on evidence. Same scope mismatch and same recommendation as RN-WPS-029; the two share a source task and should be excluded together.

RN-WPS-032.rationale: Recording patient information and vital signs is documenting patient care in the electronic health record.
RN-WPS-032.notes: v1 top CONFIRMED against the full index. Identical top to RN-WPS-020, which is correct: both tasks are clinical documentation.

RN-WPS-033.concept: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.
RN-WPS-033.rationale: Referring a patient to a specialised resource or community agency is communicating the care provided and the care needed at a transition in care.
RN-WPS-033.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0020. A referral is a care transition, which QSEN_0026 names directly; QSEN_0020's resource-access clause matched on wording but its subject is decisional conflict. QSEN_0026 was absent from the lexical set.

RN-WPS-035.concept: Supervise workers providing client or patient services.
RN-WPS-035.rationale: Observing nurses and visiting patients to ensure proper nursing care is using quality measures to understand performance.
RN-WPS-035.notes: CHANGED from v1's QSEN_0010 and now identical to RN-WPS-022, which shares the source task. Distinct from RN-WPS-034 (QSEN_0065), whose task is directing and delegating rather than observing — a difference the source tasks support.

RN-WPS-036.concept: Test biological specimens to gather information about patient conditions.
RN-WPS-036.rationale: Verified against all 207 statements: performing laboratory tests has no QSEN counterpart. QSEN_0195 concerns using data to make decisions, not producing it.
RN-WPS-036.notes: v1 status CONFIRMED on evidence. The v1 candidate set for this row was a pure lexical artifact, matching on the token 'information'; the regenerated set contains the genuinely nearest statements and none of them fit.

RN-WPS-038.concept: Treat acute illnesses, infections, or injuries.
RN-WPS-038.rationale: Providing health care, first aid and convalescent or rehabilitative assistance is the delivery of patient-centred care with sensitivity and respect.
RN-WPS-038.notes: v1 top CONFIRMED. Identical candidate set and top to RN-WPS-017, which shares the source task — the v1 inconsistency between these two rows is resolved. The mapping remains broad; a reviewer may prefer to hold both.

RN-WPS-039.rationale: Verified against all 207 statements: emergency treatment and field triage have no QSEN counterpart, and QSEN contains no general physical-assessment or diagnostic-reasoning statement.
RN-WPS-039.notes: v1 status CONFIRMED on evidence. Shares source task with RN-WPS-013 and RN-WPS-016; all three are not_mappable in v3, which required downgrading RN-WPS-016 from a v1 draft. Route to AACN Domain 2 and the NCJMM clinical judgment layer.
